words.note: 當 reading 明確指把時間花在閱讀書籍，而不是閱讀短訊、網頁或文件時，可用 reading books。這是最自然、最直接的說法之一。
words.example: She spends an hour reading books before bed.
words.exampleZh: 她睡前會花一小時看書。

exercises.original: The children spend twenty minutes reading every morning, usually choosing storybooks from the class library.
exercises.zh: 孩子們每天早上花二十分鐘閱讀，通常會從班級圖書館選故事書。
exercises.upgrade: reading books · 閱讀書籍；看書

options.explanation: studying a text = 研讀文本。通常帶有分析、理解或學習目的，不只是一般看故事書。
reading books = 閱讀書籍。storybooks from the class library 是決定性線索，直接說明閱讀的材料是書。
reading through = 從頭到尾讀一遍。通常要接受詞，例如 reading through a report。
perusing = 細閱／翻閱。語氣較正式，而且這裡只是日常閱讀習慣。
doing some reading = 做一些閱讀。太泛，沒有表明讀的是書。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。可作較正式的名詞短語，但在這個日常句子中 reading books 更自然。

exercises.original: He developed a love of reading as a teenager and now finishes several novels every month.
exercises.zh: 他青少年時期開始喜歡閱讀，現在每月都看完幾本小說。
exercises.upgrade: reading books · 閱讀書籍；看書

options.explanation: reading through documents = 把文件讀一遍。novels 顯然不是一般文件。
perusing reports = 細閱報告。材料類型不合。
doing some reading = 做一些閱讀。可以，但不能像 novels 那樣清楚表明長期看書習慣。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。較像學術或統計用名詞短語，這裡不如 reading books 自然。
reading books = 閱讀書籍。finishes several novels every month 直接支持這個說法。
studying text = 研讀文字。這裡不是學術分析。

exercises.original: Instead of watching television in the evening, she prefers reading and often borrows novels from the library.
exercises.zh: 她晚上比起看電視更喜歡看書，而且經常從圖書館借小說。
exercises.upgrade: reading books · 閱讀書籍；看書

options.explanation: reading books = 看書。borrows novels from the library 明確指出她的閱讀活動是讀書。
studying a text = 研讀文本。沒有分析或學習目的。
reading through = 讀完／通讀。缺少受詞，而且重點不是完成某一份材料。
perusing = 細閱。語體較正式，不符合一般休閒習慣。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。作活動名詞可以，但 prefers book reading 在這裡較不自然。
proofreading = 校對。是檢查錯字或格式，不是一般閱讀。

words.meaning: 逐段閱讀文本；把文本看一遍
words.note: 當 reading 指有次序地把文章、章節、報告或其他文字材料從頭到尾看過一遍時，可用 going through a text。它常帶有檢查、理解或完成閱讀的意味。
words.example: We spent the lesson going through the text paragraph by paragraph.
words.exampleZh: 我們整堂課逐段閱讀這篇文本。

exercises.original: The teacher spent the first half of the lesson reading the passage with the class, paragraph by paragraph.
exercises.zh: 老師用上半堂課和全班逐段閱讀文章。
exercises.upgrade: going through the text · 逐段閱讀文本；把文本看一遍

options.explanation: reading books = 閱讀書籍。題目說的是一篇 passage，不是一整本書。
doing some reading = 做一些閱讀。太泛，沒有 paragraph by paragraph 的逐段意味。
perusing casually = 隨意翻閱。和逐段處理不符。
going through the text = 把文本逐段看一遍。paragraph by paragraph 是最明確的線索。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。材料不是書，也不表達逐段處理。
browsing = 瀏覽。表示快速或隨意看，不是逐段閱讀。

exercises.original: Before answering the questions, students should read the article carefully from beginning to end.
exercises.zh: 回答問題前，學生應該把文章由頭到尾仔細讀一遍。
exercises.upgrade: going through the text · 逐段閱讀文本；把文本看一遍

options.explanation: studying a text = 研讀文本。也可表示深入學習，但 from beginning to end 更突出完整通讀。
reading books = 看書。article 不是一本書。
going through the text = 把文本完整看一遍。from beginning to end 是決定性線索。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。材料類型錯。
skimming = 略讀。和 carefully 相反。
doing some reading = 做些閱讀。太泛。

exercises.original: The editor is reading the report section by section before the meeting.
exercises.zh: 編輯在會議前逐節閱讀這份報告。
exercises.upgrade: going through the report · 逐段閱讀文本；把文本看一遍

options.explanation: perusing = 細閱。也接近，但 section by section 更強調有次序地逐部分處理。
reading through = 通讀。也可，但通常較突出把整份材料讀完。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。report 不是書。
going through the report = 逐段／逐節查看報告。section by section 是最自然搭配。
studying literature = 研習文學。材料和目的都不合。
browsing = 瀏覽。過於快速隨意。

words.meaning: 研讀文本；仔細研究文字內容
words.note: 當 reading 不只是把文字看完，而是為了理解、分析、學習或考試而仔細讀某篇文章、作品或資料時，可用 studying a text。
words.example: The class is studying a text about climate change.
words.exampleZh: 全班正在研讀一篇關於氣候變化的文本。

exercises.original: The students are reading the poem closely to identify its imagery, structure, and themes.
exercises.zh: 學生正在仔細研讀這首詩，以找出意象、結構和主題。
exercises.upgrade: studying the text · 研讀文本；仔細研究文字內容

options.explanation: reading books = 看書。太泛，沒有分析文學元素的意思。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。poem 並非一本書，而且缺少分析意味。
studying the text = 研讀文本。identify imagery, structure, themes 明確表示深入分析。
browsing = 瀏覽。過於隨意快速。
doing some reading = 做些閱讀。太籠統。
reading through quickly = 快速讀一遍。和 closely 相反。

exercises.original: For the exam, she spent the evening reading the historical document and making notes on every key argument.
exercises.zh: 為了考試，她整晚研讀歷史文件，並為每個主要論點做筆記。
exercises.upgrade: studying the text · 研讀文本；仔細研究文字內容

options.explanation: going through casually = 隨意看一遍。和 for the exam、making notes 不符。
studying the text = 研讀文本。考試準備加上逐個論點做筆記，是典型 study 語境。
reading books = 看書。材料是一份 historical document，不是書。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。材料類型不合。
skimming = 略讀。不能支持每個 key argument 都做筆記。
browsing = 瀏覽。太隨意。

exercises.original: The class spent two weeks reading the play in detail and discussing how each character develops.
exercises.zh: 全班用了兩星期詳細研讀這齣戲劇，並討論每個角色如何發展。
exercises.upgrade: studying the text · 研讀文本；仔細研究文字內容

options.explanation: doing some reading = 做些閱讀。不能表達兩星期深入學習。
reading through once = 讀一遍。和 two weeks、in detail 不合。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。play 是戲劇文本，而且本句強調分析。
studying the text = 研讀文本。in detail + discussing character development 明確是學習與分析。
perusing briefly = 簡略翻閱。和兩星期詳細閱讀相反。
browsing = 瀏覽。太隨意。

words.note: 當 reading 強調把某份文件、文章、草稿或章節完整讀一遍時，可用 reading through。它常接 report, draft, document, chapter 等。
words.example: I'm reading through the draft before I send it.
words.exampleZh: 我在寄出草稿前先把它完整讀一遍。

exercises.original: Before signing the contract, she spent twenty minutes reading it from beginning to end.
exercises.zh: 簽合約前，她花了二十分鐘把整份合約從頭到尾讀了一遍。
exercises.upgrade: reading through it · 通讀；從頭到尾讀一遍

options.explanation: studying literature = 研習文學。contract 不是文學作品。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。合約不是書。
reading through it = 把它通讀一遍。from beginning to end 是最直接線索。
browsing = 瀏覽。太隨意，簽約前通常需要完整閱讀。
reading books = 看書。材料不合。
skimming = 略讀。不能保證由頭到尾仔細看。

exercises.original: He is reading the final draft once more before submitting it to the journal.
exercises.zh: 他在投稿期刊前正把最終草稿再通讀一次。
exercises.upgrade: reading through the final draft · 通讀；從頭到尾讀一遍

options.explanation: perusing a novel = 細閱小說。材料不是小說。
studying a text = 研讀文本。可能過度強調學習分析，而這裡只是投稿前再完整讀一次。
reading books = 看書。錯誤材料類型。
reading through the final draft = 通讀最終草稿。once more before submitting 是典型完整檢查語境。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。無關。
browsing headlines = 瀏覽標題。完全不合。

exercises.original: Please read the instructions completely before you start assembling the machine.
exercises.zh: 開始組裝機器前，請把說明完整讀一遍。
exercises.upgrade: reading through the instructions · 通讀；從頭到尾讀一遍

options.explanation: reading through the instructions = 把說明完整讀一遍。completely 是決定性線索。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。instructions 不是書。
studying literature = 研習文學。完全不合。
perusing casually = 隨意翻閱。安全／組裝說明不應只隨意看。
reading books = 看書。材料不合。
browsing = 瀏覽。不能表示完整讀完。

words.note: peruse 常表示較正式地仔細閱讀或查看某份文件、資料、清單或文章。現代英語有時也被用作較隨意的『瀏覽』，但在學習用語中最好保留『細閱』的核心意思。
words.example: She was perusing the report before the meeting.

exercises.original: The lawyer sat quietly reading the evidence file in detail before the hearing.
exercises.zh: 律師在聆訊前安靜地仔細閱讀證據檔案。
exercises.upgrade: perusing · 細閱；仔細閱讀

options.explanation: book reading = 書籍閱讀。evidence file 不是書。
perusing = 細閱。lawyer + evidence file + in detail 是典型正式仔細閱讀語境。
doing some reading = 做些閱讀。太泛。
reading books = 看書。材料不合。
skimming = 略讀。和 in detail 相反。
going through casually = 隨意看。和聆訊前仔細查看證據不合。

exercises.original: She spent an hour reading the catalogue carefully before choosing which paintings to view.
exercises.zh: 她花了一小時仔細閱讀目錄，才決定要看哪些畫作。
exercises.upgrade: perusing · 細閱；仔細閱讀

options.explanation: reading books = 看書。catalogue 不是書籍。
browsing quickly = 快速瀏覽。和 spent an hour、carefully 不符。
perusing = 細閱。catalogue + carefully + choosing afterwards 很自然。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。材料類型不合。
studying a textbook = 研讀教科書。不是教科書。
skimming = 略讀。和 carefully 相反。

exercises.original: The researcher was reading old letters carefully in the archive, looking for references to the expedition.
exercises.zh: 研究員在檔案館仔細閱讀舊信，尋找有關遠征的記載。
exercises.upgrade: perusing · 細閱；仔細閱讀

options.explanation: perusing = 細閱。archive + old letters + looking for references 表示仔細查看資料。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。letters 不是書。
reading books = 看書。材料不合。
browsing social media = 瀏覽社交媒體。完全無關。
skimming = 略讀。找特定歷史線索時，題目強調 carefully。
doing light reading = 輕鬆閱讀。研究檔案不是消閒閱讀。

words.note: book reading 是較正式或研究性的名詞短語，常出現在 book-reading habits, shared book reading, time spent on book reading 等語境。日常英語通常直接說 reading books。它有時也可指『作者朗讀作品的公開活動』，因此需看上下文。
words.example: The study examined children's book-reading habits at home.
words.exampleZh: 這項研究探討兒童在家的書籍閱讀習慣。

exercises.original: The survey examined children's reading habits at home, specifically how often they read books with their parents.
exercises.zh: 調查研究兒童在家的書籍閱讀習慣，特別是他們多久會和父母一起看書。
exercises.upgrade: book reading · 書籍閱讀；讀書活動

options.explanation: studying text = 研讀文本。問卷不是研究兒童如何分析文本。
going through reports = 閱讀報告。材料完全不合。
perusing = 細閱。不是描述習慣類別的名詞。
proofreading = 校對。無關。
reading through = 通讀。不是一種長期習慣名稱。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。book-reading habits 是自然的研究／教育搭配，而且下文直接說 read books with parents。

exercises.original: Researchers measured the amount of time families spent on reading books together each week.
exercises.zh: 研究人員量度家庭每週一起閱讀書籍所花的時間。
exercises.upgrade: book reading · 書籍閱讀；讀書活動

options.explanation: book reading = 書籍閱讀。在研究語境中，time spent on book reading 是自然的正式名詞短語。
reading through = 通讀。需要具體材料，且不表示一項家庭活動類型。
perusing = 細閱。不是測量活動類別的名詞用法。
studying a text = 研讀文本。家庭共讀未必有學術分析目的。
proofreading = 校對。不是家庭共讀。
browsing = 瀏覽。太隨意，也不特指書籍。

exercises.original: The education report found that regular reading of books at home was associated with a larger vocabulary.
exercises.zh: 教育報告發現，在家定期閱讀書籍和較大的詞彙量有關。
exercises.upgrade: book reading · 書籍閱讀；讀書活動

options.explanation: going through books once = 把書讀一遍。沒有 regular habit 的概念。
perusing documents = 細閱文件。材料類型不合。
studying text = 研讀文本。可能太偏學術分析。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。education report + regular... at home 是自然研究型用法。
proofreading = 校對。無關。
skimming = 略讀。不能代表規律閱讀習慣。

words.note: 這是很自然的口語說法，當 reading 不必指特定書本或文件，只表示花時間閱讀、查資料或為某課題讀一些材料時，可用 doing some reading。
words.example: I need to do some reading before tomorrow's seminar.
words.exampleZh: 我明天研討課前要先讀一些資料。

exercises.original: I have some reading to do before tomorrow's seminar, but there is no single assigned textbook.
exercises.zh: 我明天研討課前要讀一些資料，但沒有指定單一教科書。
exercises.upgrade: doing some reading · 做些閱讀；讀點東西

options.explanation: book reading = 書籍閱讀。題目明確說沒有單一指定教科書，可能包括文章等多種材料。
reading through one document = 通讀一份文件。範圍太窄。
doing some reading = 做些閱讀。最自然地表示為課堂準備而讀一些未特定的材料。
proofreading = 校對。不是準備課堂內容。
perusing one file = 細閱一份檔案。太具體。
skimming headlines = 瀏覽標題。通常不足以準備 seminar。

exercises.original: She spent Sunday afternoon reading for her history project, using several articles and websites.
exercises.zh: 她星期日下午為歷史專題讀了一些資料，包括多篇文章和網站。
exercises.upgrade: doing some reading · 做些閱讀；讀點東西

options.explanation: perusing one book = 細閱一本書。材料包括 several articles and websites，不是一本書。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。材料不只書籍。
reading through a single text = 通讀單一文本。和 several sources 不符。
doing some reading = 做些閱讀。很適合描述為 project 查閱多種資料。
proofreading = 校對。不是閱讀研究資料。
browsing only = 只瀏覽。可能過於表面，題目只是說在閱讀準備。

exercises.original: Before choosing a new laptop, he did a lot of reading about battery life, repairability, and long-term reliability.
exercises.zh: 買新手提電腦前，他讀了很多有關電池續航、可維修性和長期可靠性的資料。
exercises.upgrade: doing some reading · 做些閱讀；讀點東西

options.explanation: doing some reading = 做些閱讀／查閱資料。about several product factors 表示廣泛查資料，最自然。
book reading = 書籍閱讀。購買研究通常不只來自書籍。
studying one text = 研讀一篇文本。範圍太窄。
reading through one manual = 通讀一本手冊。題目沒有指定單一手冊。
proofreading = 校對。無關。
reading novels = 讀小說。完全不合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 讀；閱讀不等於一般的 reading read 是動詞；reading 可以是動名詞、名詞或活動名稱。兩者詞性和句法位置不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You read a book; reading can be an activity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 讀者；閱讀器不等於一般的 reading reader 是閱讀的人，或電子閱讀裝置／教材，不是 reading 這個活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A reader does the reading.

falseSynonyms.zh: 讀寫能力不等於一般的 reading literacy 是讀寫能力，不是實際進行閱讀這個活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Literacy is the ability to read and write; reading is the activity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 寫作不等於一般的 reading writing 是產生文字；reading 是理解別人寫下的文字。兩者互相關聯，但不是同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Writing produces text; reading interprets it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 校對不等於一般的 reading proofreading 是特別為找錯字、文法、格式或排版問題而閱讀。它只是 reading 的一種特殊用途。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Proofreading checks a text for errors.

falseSynonyms.zh: 略讀不等於一般的 reading skimming 是快速抓大意，只看重點，不等於一般或仔細的 reading。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Skimming is a fast type of reading.

falseSynonyms.zh: 瀏覽不等於一般的 reading browsing 強調隨意、快速查看內容或選項，通常比 reading 更不深入。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Browsing is more casual and selective than reading.

falseSynonyms.zh: 書評不等於一般的 reading book review 是對一本書的評論文章或評論行為，不是閱讀書籍本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You normally read a book before writing a book review.
